description: This file defines the LruArrayCache class, which implements a simple in-memory Least Recently Used (LRU) cache using PHP's associative arrays. It provides methods for getting, setting, and removing cache entries, with automatic eviction of the least recently used items when the cache exceeds a maximum size.

classes.name: LruArrayCache
classes.description: Class implementing an in-memory cache with LRU eviction policy, supporting CacheInterface and Countable, managing cache size and entry expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize cache with optional maximum items limit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry by key, updates usage order, and checks expiration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache entry with optional TTL, evicting least recently used items if necessary.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items currently in the cache.
